title: Harees with Middle Eastern Twist
description: A traditional Middle Eastern dish with a unique twist, perfect for a hearty meal. Harees is a slow-cooked wheat porridge typically served with meat.

ingredients.name: Middle Eastern spices
ingredients.notes: a mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon

instructions: Rinse the wheat and soak it in water for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the wheat again, then place it in a large pot with 4 cups of water.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the wheat is tender.
Add the Middle Eastern spices, onion, and garlic to the pot and continue to simmer for another 30 minutes.
Use a fork to mash some of the wheat against the side of the pot to thicken the harees.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
